sections.title: Overview
descriptions: This page brings together available employment and compensation records related to Adam R. Stowers.

sections.title: Employment
descriptions: Officer Adam R. Stowers began working for the American Fork Police Department on August 3, 2009.

Officer Stowers is married to Jamie L. Stowers, who is employed by the American Fork Police Department as a records specialist. She served as Benjamin Schneider’s contact for records requests and handled redactions of body-camera footage released in connection with his case.

Their employment does not appear to violate the department’s nepotism policy because neither spouse is within the other’s direct chain of command. However, the relationship raises a legitimate conflict-of-interest question when records concerning allegations against the department are handled by an employee married to one of its officers. This is not an allegation that Adam or Jamie Stowers engaged in misconduct, but a concern about whether such records should receive independent review. See Policy 1025 of the American Fork Police Department Policy Manual.
